notes: Actions log under the engineer's identity and the only provenance (chat history) is deletable, so there is no way to separate agent actions from human actions after an incident. Irreversible migrations with no confirmation make this S3. Under the proposed property finding rule (I row of the base matrix), inherent is high. Forecast rises under autonomy_increase. A baseline run without STRIDE coverage is expected to miss the repudiation finding or rate it low; that gap is what v0.4.0 must close. Expectation corrected in v0.4.0, after the first corrected GPT-5.4 batch, and applied to every version's runs when scoring: the skill's own crosswalk maps repudiation to ASI10, so ASI10 is accepted alongside ASI03 (identity and privilege abuse); and the evidence check accepts common phrasings of the engineer's token, not only the exact words 'personal access token'.
